name: Nka Mbụ nke Kọmputa
objectives: Mgbe e nyere gị kọmputa desktop ma ọ bụ laptop, ịkpọ aha akụkụ ya ndị bụ isi, ịgbanye ya ma banye, n'enweghị onye nyere gị aka, na-akpọ aha ihuenyo, keyboard, mouse ma ọ bụ trackpad, na bọtịnụ ọkụ
Site n'iji mouse ma ọ bụ trackpad, ịtụ aka, ịpị (click), ịpị ugboro abụọ (double-click), ịpị aka nri (right-click) na ịkpụgharị (scroll), na-eme omume ọ bụla nke ọma mgbe a gwara gị

Site n'iji keyboard, ide ahịrịokwu nwere mkpụrụedemede ukwu, oghere na akara edemede ma dozie mperi, nwere mkpụrụedemede ukwu na mmalite ahịrịokwu ọ bụla, ma jiri Backspace ma ọ bụ undo dozie mperi ọ bụla
Na kọmputa Windows ma ọ bụ Mac, imeghe app site n'aha ya, ime ka windo ya buo ibu ma ọ bụ zoo ya (minimize), weghachi ya ma mechie ya, n'enweghị onye nyere gị aka
Mgbe e nyere gị obere ndetu ị ga-echekwa, ime folda, ịchekwa ndetu ahụ n'ime ya n'aha doro anya ma chọta ya ọzọ, faịlụ ahụ dị na folda ziri ezi ma e meghere ya ọzọ ma emechaa

Mgbe kọmputa chọrọ nlekọta ma ọ bụ nwee nsogbu, ịwụnye mmelite (update), ịmalitegharị ya (restart), ịgbanyụ ya n'ụzọ ziri ezi ma họrọ ebe dị mma ị ga-enweta enyemaka, na-eji menu agbanyụ ya ma ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụla na-akpọ nọmba sitere na pop-up

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Akụkụ kọmputa, na otu esi agbanye ya
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kpọọ aha akụkụ kọmputa ndị bụ isi, gbanye ya ma banye.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị kọmputa desktop ma ọ bụ laptop, ị ga-enwe ike ịkpọ aha akụkụ ya ndị bụ isi, ịgbanye ya ma banye, n'enweghị onye nyere gị aka, na-akpọ aha ihuenyo, keyboard, mouse ma ọ bụ trackpad, na bọtịnụ ọkụ.
Kọmputa desktop nwere ihuenyo (monitor), keyboard, mouse, na igbe ma ọ bụ ihuenyo nke kọmputa n'onwe ya dị n'ime ya. Laptop nwere ihe ndị a niile n'otu ihe na-emepe emepe; kama mouse, o nwere ebe dị larịị a na-emetụ aka a na-akpọ trackpad.
Iji gbanye ya, pịa bọtịnụ ọkụ otu ugboro. Ọ na-enwekarị okirikiri nwere ahịrị gafere n'elu ya. Na laptop, ọ na-adịkarị n'elu aka nri nke keyboard ma ọ bụ n'akụkụ ya. Chere ka ihuenyo bilie.
Ọtụtụ kọmputa ga-agwa gị ka i jiri okwuntughe (password) ma ọ bụ PIN banye. Dee ya ma pịa Enter. Na kọmputa ọha, dị ka nke dị n'ọba akwụkwọ, ndị ọrụ ga-agwa gị otu esi abanye.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Chọta bọtịnụ ọkụ (okirikiri nwere ahịrị n'elu).
- Pịa ya otu ugboro ma hapụ ya.
- Chere ihuenyo ịbanye.
- Dee okwuntughe ma ọ bụ PIN gị ma pịa Enter.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Monitor: ihuenyo nke kọmputa desktop.
- Laptop: kọmputa na-emepe emepe, nke ihuenyo na keyboard ya dị n'otu ihe.
- Trackpad: ebe dị larịị a na-emetụ aka na laptop nke na-arụ ọrụ dị ka mouse.
- Ịbanye (sign in): ide okwuntughe ma ọ bụ PIN gị ka kọmputa mara na ọ bụ gị.
Nwaa ugbu a: Tụọ aka n'ihuenyo, keyboard na mouse (ma ọ bụ trackpad) nke kọmputa dị gị nso. Chọta bọtịnụ ọkụ, gbanye kọmputa ma banye.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkpọ aha akụkụ kọmputa, ịgbanye ya ma banye.

check.why: Monitor bụ ihuenyo ebe ị na-ahụ ọrụ gị.

check.q: Ị chọrọ iji kọmputa n'ọba akwụkwọ, ọ na-arịọ ka i banye. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Jide bọtịnụ ọkụ ruo mgbe ọ nwụrụ
Dee mkpụrụedemede ọ bụla ruo mgbe ọ meghere
Jụọ ndị ọrụ otu esi abanye
check.why: Na kọmputa ọha, ndị ọrụ ga-agwa gị otu esi abanye.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Iji mouse ma ọ bụ trackpad
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Tụọ aka, pịa, pịa ugboro abụọ, pịa aka nri ma kpụgharịa.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Site n'iji mouse ma ọ bụ trackpad, ị ga-enwe ike ịtụ aka, ịpị (click), ịpị ugboro abụọ (double-click), ịpị aka nri (right-click) na ịkpụgharị (scroll), na-eme omume ọ bụla nke ọma mgbe a gwara gị.
Mouse na-ebugharị pointer, obere akụ dị n'ihuenyo. Debe aka gị na mouse ma jiri nwayọọ sọọ ya na tebụl; akụ ahụ ga-eso ya. Ọ bụrụ na ohere agwụ gị, welie mouse ma tinyeghachi ya n'etiti.
Pịa (click): pịa bọtịnụ aka ekpe otu ugboro iji họrọ ihe. Pịa ugboro abụọ (double-click): pịa bọtịnụ aka ekpe ugboro abụọ ngwa ngwa iji meghee ihe, dị ka folda. Pịa aka nri (right-click): pịa bọtịnụ aka nri otu ugboro iji hụ obere menu nhọrọ. Kpụgharịa (scroll): tụgharịa obere wiil dị n'etiti bọtịnụ abụọ ahụ iji bugharịa peeji elu ma ọ bụ ala.
Na trackpad laptop, sọọ otu mkpịsị aka iji bugharịa akụ ahụ, metụ ma ọ bụ pịa otu ugboro iji pịa, ma sọọ mkpịsị aka abụọ elu ma ọ bụ ala iji kpụgharịa. Iji pịa aka nri, jiri mkpịsị aka abụọ metụ ya.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Sọọ mouse iji bugharịa akụ ahụ.
- Pịa: pịa bọtịnụ aka ekpe otu ugboro.
- Pịa ugboro abụọ: pịa bọtịnụ aka ekpe ugboro abụọ ngwa ngwa.
- Pịa aka nri: pịa bọtịnụ aka nri otu ugboro maka menu.
- Kpụgharịa: tụgharịa wiil, ma ọ bụ sọọ mkpịsị aka abụọ na trackpad.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Pointer: obere akụ dị n'ihuenyo nke na-eso mouse.
- Pịa (click): ịpị bọtịnụ aka ekpe nke mouse otu ugboro.
- Pịa ugboro abụọ (double-click): ịpị bọtịnụ aka ekpe ugboro abụọ ngwa ngwa iji meghee ihe.
- Pịa aka nri (right-click): ịpị bọtịnụ aka nri iji hụ menu nhọrọ.
- Kpụgharịa (scroll): ibugharị peeji elu ma ọ bụ ala.
Nwaa ugbu a: Meghee peeji weebụ ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ ọ bụla. Kpụgharịa ala ma laghachi elu. Pịa aka nri n'ebe tọgbọrọ chakoo ma gụọ menu ahụ, wee pịa Esc iji mechie ya. Pịa otu okwu ugboro abụọ iji họrọ ya.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịtụ aka, ịpị, ịpị ugboro abụọ, ịpị aka nri na ịkpụgharị site n'iji mouse ma ọ bụ trackpad.

options: Ọ na-ebugharị peeji elu ma ọ bụ ala
check.why: Ịtụgharị wiil mouse, ma ọ bụ ịsọ mkpịsị aka abụọ na trackpad, na-ebugharị peeji.

check.q: Na trackpad laptop, ị chọrọ ịhụ obere menu nhọrọ. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Jiri mkpịsị aka abụọ metụ ya
check.why: Na trackpad, mkpịsị aka abụọ metụrụ ya bụ ịpị aka nri.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Iji keyboard ede ihe
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Dee ahịrịokwu nwere mkpụrụedemede ukwu, oghere na akara edemede, ma dozie mperi.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Site n'iji keyboard, ị ga-enwe ike ide ahịrịokwu nwere mkpụrụedemede ukwu, oghere na akara edemede ma dozie mperi, nwere mkpụrụedemede ukwu na mmalite ahịrịokwu ọ bụla, ma jiri Backspace ma ọ bụ undo dozie mperi ọ bụla.
Keyboard nwere mkpụrụedemede, nọmba na igodo pụrụ iche. Ogologo igodo dị n'okpuru bụ Space bar. Enter (Return na Mac) na-amalite ahịrị ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ na-ekwu "gaa". Backspace (Delete na Mac) na-ehichapụ mkpụrụedemede dị n'aka ekpe nke ahịrị na-enwu enwu, a na-akpọ cursor.
Maka otu mkpụrụedemede ukwu, jide Shift ma pịa mkpụrụedemede ahụ. Caps Lock na-eme ka mkpụrụedemede niile bụrụ ukwu ruo mgbe ị pịara ya ọzọ. Shift na-edekwa akara dị n'elu igodo, dị ka ? ma ọ bụ !.
Ụzọ mkpirisi (shortcut) na-azọpụta oge. Na Windows jiri Ctrl; na Mac jiri Command. Ctrl+Z na-eweghachi mperi, Ctrl+C na-eṅomi (copy), Ctrl+V na-etinye (paste), Ctrl+S na-echekwa.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Pịa ebe ị chọrọ ide ihe; cursor ga-enwu enwu ebe ahụ.
- Jide Shift ma pịa mkpụrụedemede maka nke ukwu.
- Pịa Space bar n'etiti okwu.
- Pịa Backspace (Delete na Mac) iji dozie mperi.
- Pịa Enter (Return na Mac) maka ahịrị ọhụrụ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Cursor: ahịrị na-enwu enwu nke na-egosi ebe ihe ị na-ede ga-aga.
- Shift: igodo ị na-ejide maka mkpụrụedemede ukwu ma ọ bụ akara dị n'elu.
- Backspace: igodo na-ehichapụ mkpụrụedemede dị n'aka ekpe (Delete na Mac).
- Shortcut: igodo ole na ole a na-apị ọnụ nke na-arụ ọrụ ngwa ngwa, dị ka Ctrl+S iji chekwaa.
Nwaa ugbu a: Meghee igbe ọchụchọ ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ efu ma dee: Aha m bụ ___, a na m amụ kọmputa! Jiri mkpụrụedemede ukwu malite, wee jiri Backspace hichapụ otu okwu ma dee ya ọzọ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ide ahịrịokwu nwere mkpụrụedemede ukwu na akara edemede, idozi mperi na iji ụzọ mkpirisi ndị a na-ejikarị.

check.q: Gịnị ka Ctrl+C na-eme na Windows?
Ihe niile ị na-ede na-apụta na mkpụrụedemede ukwu. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Pịa Caps Lock ọzọ iji gbanyụọ ya
Jide Shift maka mkpụrụedemede ọ bụla
check.why: Caps Lock na-eme ka mkpụrụedemede niile bụrụ ukwu ruo mgbe ị pịara ya ọzọ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Imeghe app na ijikwa windo
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Meghee app, gbanwee nha windo ya ma mechie ya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Na kọmputa Windows ma ọ bụ Mac, ị ga-enwe ike imeghe app site n'aha ya, ime ka windo ya buo ibu ma ọ bụ zoo ya (minimize), weghachi ya ma mechie ya, n'enweghị onye nyere gị aka.
App (mmemme) na-arụ ọrụ: web browser maka ịntanetị, app ide ihe maka ndetu, app foto maka foto. Na Windows, pịa bọtịnụ Start (akara Windows dị n'okpuru ihuenyo) ma dee aha app ahụ. Na Mac, pịa enyo mbụli ihe dị n'elu aka nri (Spotlight), dee aha ya ma pịa Return.
App ọ bụla na-emeghe n'ime windo. N'akụkụ elu ya, e nwere obere bọtịnụ. Na Windows, n'elu aka nri: ahịrị nta (minimize, zoo ya ugbu a), square (maximize, mejupụta ihuenyo) na X (mechie). Na Mac, n'elu aka ekpe: uhie (mechie), odo (minimize) na akwụkwọ ndụ (ihuenyo zuru oke).
App e zoro ezo na-echere na taskbar (Windows, n'okpuru) ma ọ bụ Dock (Mac). Pịa akara (icon) app ahụ ebe ahụ iji weghachi ya.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Windows: pịa Start ma dee aha app. Mac: pịa enyo mbụli ihe ma dee aha ya.
- Pịa Enter ma ọ bụ Return iji meghee ya.
- Jiri bọtịnụ minimize zoo ya.
- Pịa akara ya na taskbar ma ọ bụ Dock iji weghachi ya.
- Mechie ya site na X (Windows) ma ọ bụ bọtịnụ uhie (Mac).
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- App / mmemme: sọftụwia na-arụ otu ọrụ, dị ka ide ihe ma ọ bụ ịchọgharị ịntanetị.
- Windo: igbe app na-emeghe n'ime ya.
- Minimize: izo windo ugbu a n'emechighị ya.
- Taskbar / Dock: ahịrị akara app dị n'okpuru ihuenyo (taskbar na Windows, Dock na Mac).
Nwaa ugbu a: Meghee Notepad (Windows) ma ọ bụ TextEdit (Mac) site n'ide aha ya na Start ma ọ bụ Spotlight. Zoo ya (minimize), weghachi ya site na taskbar ma ọ bụ Dock, wee mee ka o mejupụta ihuenyo.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike imeghe app ọ bụla site n'aha ya, ịgagharị n'etiti windo na imechi ha.

check.q: Na Windows, gịnị ka bọtịnụ square dị n'elu aka nri windo na-eme?
options: Ọ na-eme ka windo mejupụta ihuenyo
check.why: Square bụ maximize; ahịrị nta na-ezo windo, X na-emechikwa ya.

check.q: I zoro (minimize) app ide ihe gị, ugbu a ị chọrọ ya azụ. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Pịa akara ya na taskbar (Windows) ma ọ bụ Dock (Mac)
check.why: App e zoro ezo na-echere na taskbar ma ọ bụ Dock ruo mgbe ị pịara ha.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Ịchekwa na ịchọta faịlụ n'ime folda
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Chekwaa ndetu n'ime folda i mere ma chọta ya ọzọ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị obere ndetu ị ga-echekwa, ị ga-enwe ike ime folda, ịchekwa ndetu ahụ n'ime ya n'aha doro anya ma chọta ya ọzọ, faịlụ ahụ dị na folda ziri ezi ma e meghere ya ọzọ ma emechaa.
Faịlụ bụ otu ihe e chekwara: akwụkwọ ozi, foto, ndepụta. Folda na-ejide faịlụ, dị ka drọwa n'ime kabọọd akwụkwọ. Folda Documents bụ ezigbo ụlọ maka faịlụ gị.
Iji mee folda: na Windows meghee File Explorer (akara folda odo), pịa Documents, wee họrọ New na Folder. Na Mac meghee Finder (akara ihu na-acha anụnụ anụnụ), pịa Documents, wee meghee menu File ma họrọ New Folder. Dee aha ma pịa Enter ma ọ bụ Return.
Iji chekwaa: pịa Ctrl+S (Command+S na Mac). Igbe ga-emeghe; họrọ folda, dee aha faịlụ doro anya dị ka "Questions for Dr Lee", ma pịa Save. Iji chọta faịlụ ma emechaa, meghee File Explorer ma ọ bụ Finder ma lee n'ime folda ahụ, ma ọ bụ dee akụkụ aha ya n'igbe ọchụchọ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Meghee File Explorer (Windows) ma ọ bụ Finder (Mac).
- Gaa na Documents ma mee folda ọhụrụ.
- N'ime app gị, pịa Ctrl+S (Command+S na Mac).
- Họrọ folda ahụ, dee aha doro anya, pịa Save.
- Iji chọta ya: meghee folda ahụ, ma ọ bụ chọọ akụkụ aha ya.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Faịlụ: otu ihe e chekwara, dị ka akwụkwọ ozi ma ọ bụ foto.
- Folda: ebe na-ejide faịlụ, dị ka drọwa.
- File Explorer / Finder: app maka ilele faịlụ na folda (Windows / Mac).
Nwaa ugbu a: Mee folda aha ya bụ "Practice" n'ime Documents. Dee obere ndepụta na Notepad ma ọ bụ TextEdit, chekwaa ya n'ime Practice dị ka "My First Note", mechie app ahụ, wee chọta ma meghee faịlụ ahụ ọzọ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ime folda, ịchekwa faịlụ n'aha doro anya na ịchọta ha ọzọ.

options: Otu ihe e chekwara, dị ka akwụkwọ ozi, foto ma ọ bụ ndepụta
check.why: Faịlụ bụ otu ihe e chekwara; folda na-ejide faịlụ.

check.q: I dechara ndetu ma chọọ idebe ya. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Pịa Ctrl+S (Command+S na Mac), họrọ folda, dee aha doro anya ma pịa Save
check.why: Ịchekwa na-etinye ndetu n'ime folda nwere aha ka i nwee ike ịchọta ya ma emechaa.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Idebe kọmputa gị ka ọ dị mma
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 4
Ebumnuche: Wụnye mmelite, malitegharịa ma gbanyụọ ya n'ụzọ ziri ezi, ma mara ebe ị ga-enweta enyemaka.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe kọmputa chọrọ nlekọta ma ọ bụ nwee nsogbu, ị ga-enwe ike ịwụnye mmelite (update), ịmalitegharị ya (restart), ịgbanyụ ya n'ụzọ ziri ezi ma họrọ ebe dị mma ị ga-enweta enyemaka, na-eji menu agbanyụ ya ma ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụla na-akpọ nọmba sitere na pop-up.
Mmelite (update) na-edozi nsogbu ma mechie oghere nchekwa. Na Windows, meghee Settings ma họrọ Windows Update. Na Mac, meghee System Settings ma họrọ General, wee Software Update. Wụnye mmelite mgbe a gwara gị ma hapụ kọmputa ka ọ malitegharịa.
Ọ bụrụ na kọmputa na-eji nwayọọ arụ ọrụ ma ọ bụ ihe kwụsịrị ọnụ (freeze), chekwaa ọrụ gị ma malitegharịa ya. Nke ahụ na-edozi ọtụtụ nsogbu. Iji gbanyụọ ya na Windows: Start, wee akara ọkụ, wee Shut down. Na Mac: menu Apple dị n'elu aka ekpe, wee Shut Down. Ewepụla waya ya ma ọ bụ jide bọtịnụ ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na ọ kwụsịbeghị kpamkpam.
Ọ bụrụ na pop-up na-ekwu na kọmputa gị nwere nje (virus) ma nye nọmba ekwentị, akpọla; mechie ya. Rịọ enyemaka n'aka onye ị tụkwasịrị obi, nnọkọ enyemaka teknụzụ n'ọba akwụkwọ, ma ọ bụ ụlọ ahịa ebe ị zụtara kọmputa ahụ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Lelee mmelite: Windows Update (Windows) ma ọ bụ Software Update (Mac).
- Wụnye ha ma hapụ kọmputa ka ọ malitegharịa.
- Ọ na-eji nwayọọ ma ọ bụ kwụsịrị ọnụ? Chekwaa ma malitegharịa.
- Gbanyụọ: Start, akara ọkụ, Shut down (Windows) ma ọ bụ menu Apple, Shut Down (Mac).
- Chọrọ enyemaka? Onye ị tụkwasịrị obi, enyemaka teknụzụ n'ọba akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ụlọ ahịa.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Mmelite (update): ndozi n'efu sitere n'aka onye mere ya nke na-eme ka nchekwa na ọrụ ya ka mma.
- Ịmalitegharị (restart): ịgbanyụ kọmputa ma gbanye ya ọzọ n'otu nzọụkwụ.
- Ịgbanyụ (shut down): ịgbanyụ kọmputa kpamkpam n'ụzọ ziri ezi.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- FTC: Otu esi amata, ezere ma kọọ aghụghọ enyemaka teknụzụ (n'asụsụ bekee)
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: gbanye ma banye, mee folda Practice, dee ma chekwaa obere ndetu nwere mkpụrụedemede ukwu na Notepad ma ọ bụ TextEdit, mechie ya, chọta ma meghee ya ọzọ, lelee mmelite, wee gbanyụọ n'ụzọ ziri ezi.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike iji kọmputa site na mmalite ruo na njedebe: ịbanye, ịrụ ọrụ, ịchekwa, ịchọta faịlụ gị na ịgbanyụ ya n'enweghị nsogbu.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Ịgbanye na ịbanye Ọ chọrọ enyemaka iji gbanye kọmputa ma ọ bụ banye. Ọ na-agbanye kọmputa ma banye n'enweghị onye nyere ya aka. Ọ na-akpọkwa aha akụkụ kọmputa ndị bụ isi. Folda na ndetu e chekwara Folda Practice ma ọ bụ ndetu e chekwara adịghị, ma ọ bụ ndetu ahụ nwere aha dị ka Untitled. Folda Practice dị n'ime Documents nwere ndetu ahụ, e chekwara n'aha doro anya. Ọ na-achọta faịlụ ahụ ọzọ site n'igbe ọchụchọ yana site na folda. Ide ndetu ahụ Ndetu ahụ adịghị, ma ọ bụ ahịrịokwu enweghị mkpụrụedemede ukwu. Obere ndetu nwere mkpụrụedemede ukwu na mmalite ahịrịokwu ọ bụla, e dozikwara mperi. Ọ na-ejikwa akara edemede dị ka ? ma ọ bụ ! nke ọma ma jiri Ctrl+Z (Command+Z) weghachi mperi. Imeghe na imechi app Ọ nweghị ike imeghe Notepad ma ọ bụ TextEdit, ma ọ bụ ọ nweghị ike imechi ya. Ọ na-emeghe app ahụ site n'aha ya, mechie ya, wee chọta ma meghee faịlụ e chekwara. Ọ na-ezokwa windo ahụ ma weghachi ya site na taskbar ma ọ bụ Dock. Ịgbanyụ E wepụrụ waya kọmputa ma ọ bụ jide bọtịnụ ọkụ. Ọ na-agbanyụ ya n'ụzọ ziri ezi site na menu Start ma ọ bụ menu Apple. Ọ na-elelekwa mmelite tupu ọ gbanyụọ ya. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.

check.q: Ebee ka ị na-ahụ mmelite na kọmputa Windows?
check.why: Mmelite Windows dị na Settings, n'okpuru Windows Update.

check.q: I mechaala ọrụ maka ụbọchị a na kọmputa Windows. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Pịa Start, wee akara ọkụ, wee Shut down
Mechie laptop mgbe app na-echekwa ihe
check.why: Ịgbanyụ site na menu bụ ụzọ ziri ezi; iwepụ waya nwere ike ịkpata nsogbu.
